blocks.html: Hey Kids! Grab your dancing shoes because Robinsons Malls is bringing the award winning Hi-5 to a stage near you! You’ll sing, dance and party along with your favourite friends this May, when Hi-5 return to the Philippines for their Some Kind of Wonderful show that is full of fun for the whole family! Hi-5 is a popular group of young entertainers from Australia who make learning fun! Their “play-based learning” is anchored on educational theories disguised with music & movement which promotes individual growth, cognitive & language development and visual awareness. Hi-5 entertain audiences both young and old, being primarily aimed at aged 1-8. Be part of the Hi-5 action and join Bailey, Courtney, Joe, Lachie and Shay in their first international appearance! In the TV series, Courtney, 18, loves playing with words! She explores the wonderful world of language and sound together with her best friend Chatterbox or Chats for short. Lachie, 19, just loves exploring shapes in space in the most fun and imaginative way! Bailey, 19 is our body-moving girl and will have you up on your feet moving and grooving the whole day through! Got a puzzle to solve? Then Shay is your girl. With the help of cheeky Jup Jup she can make a day with puzzles and patterns be as fun and creative as possible and teach the inquisitive child to think creatively. And Joe, 24, the musician of the group will bring out the musical side of your child and even get the parents humming and dancing along! Head to your nearest Robinsons Malls this May to sing, dance and have a Some Kind of Wonderful time with Hi-5! Schedule of shows: Robinsons Las Pinas on May 4 (Thurs) at 4 & 6pm; Forum Robinsons on May 5 (Fri) at 4 & 6pm; Robinsons Galleria on May 6 (Sat) at 2, 4 & 6pm; Robinsons Magnolia on May 7 (Sun) at 2, 4 & 6pm; Robinsons Malolos on May 9 (Tues) at 4 & 6pm; Robinsons Jaro on May 10 (Wed) at 3 & 5pm; Robinsons Imus on May 12 (Fri) at 4 & 6pm; Robinsons Metro East on May 13 (Sat) at 2, 4 & 6pm; Robinsons Galleria Cebu on May 14 (Sun) at 2, 4 & 6pm; Robinsons Manila on May 16 (Tues) at 2, 4, & 6pm; Robinsons Gen. Trias on May 18 (Thurs) at 4 & 6pm; Robinsons Lipa on May 19 (Fri) at 4 & 6pm; Robinsons Antipolo on May 20 (Sat) at 2, 4, & 6pm; and Robinsons Bacolod on May 21 (Sun) at 2, 4 & 6pm To know more about other Robinsons Malls events and activities, visit www.robinsonsmalls.com or follow www.facebook.com/RobinsonsMalls; Twitter: @RobinsonsMalls; and Instagram: @RobinsonsMallsOfficial. About Hi-5: Hi-5 was launched in Australia in 1998 with five dynamic performers entertaining children aged 1-8 with music, movement, problem solving and play. Eighteen years later, the children’s musical group is well known around the world with an estimated audience of more than ten million children globally with its tours, music and TV shows. The Hi-5 television series is one of the top-rated shows on Disney Junior in Asia. Hi-5 has over 600 episodes featuring the Australian cast. Hi-5 has won three Logie Awards for Most Outstanding Children’s Program, five ARIA Awards for Best Children’s Album, five Australian DVD and Video Industry Awards, an APRA Award, an AIMIA Award and a Helpmann Award. The group also holds two Apollo Award Nominations for Best Music Composition for Hi-5 House Series 1 and 2 and most recently Best Preschool programme at the Asian Television Awards in 2015.
